title: And I’m back!
content: Hey guys, I had not had a mall world dream in like 2 weeks. Last night, I was back in mall world. Had a vivid experience of shopping with my friend, she pulled up in a camper style van. Other NPC people were questioning her about it. Anyway, she helped me pick out some clothes and we hit the town, went shopping in the outdoor dorm/campus mall town. It feels kinda good to be back
